_about: Adversarial-review sign-off registry. Coverage EXPANSION is gated the same way REMOVAL is: every CHECK id in coverage_lock.json must be covered by a sign-off here recording that an INDEPENDENT reviewer re-read the pinned spec at the check's cited clause and confirmed the check binds the right subject, cites faithfully, and is not over-strict. verify_review_signoffs.py fails the build if a locked CHECK id has no valid sign-off — so a future session cannot grow coverage while skipping the review that keeps it honest. A sign-off needs: reviewer, date, spec_reverified=true, notes (what was checked), and the ids it covers. Add new checks to a NEW sign-off batch after their review; never backfill an unreviewed id into an existing batch.

signoffs.reviewer: independent adversarial review, waves 1-3 (skeptic agent re-reading each pinned clause)
signoffs.notes: The initial coverage across all three pinned versions was built via parallel TDD waves and then adversarially re-reviewed in three passes for wrong subject-binding, citation stretch, over-strictness, vacuous kill-proofs, and version leakage. Findings F1..Fn were applied (including removing the unsound SIG-035). Every id below was live and kill-rate-validated at the time of the baseline lock. Subsequent additions must be signed off in their own batch.

signoffs.reviewer: independent adversarial review (agent re-read pinned checkout-mcp.md + catalog/mcp.md against each check)
signoffs.notes: Added 3 MCP JSON-RPC-2.0 transport-conformance checks for 2026-04-08 (mcp.checkout_via_tools_call, mcp.error_conformance, mcp.catalog_via_tools_call) covering MCP-003/004/006. Independent review verified the structuredContent path (checkout-mcp.md:212-213 / catalog-mcp.md:160-164) and jsonrpc:'2.0' requirement, and REFUTED two over-strictness bugs which were then FIXED before shipping: (1) checkout check no longer requires top-level id/status (checkout-response shape, legitimately absent from an all-out-of-stock error result) — asserts only the JSON-RPC envelope + ucp; (2) error check no longer requires HTTP 200 (spec pins the JSON-RPC body, not the transport status) and tests an unknown METHOD (unambiguous JSON-RPC-2.0 -32601) rather than an unknown tool name (which checkout-mcp.md leaves to MCP convention). All 3 clean-pass + kill-safe on the controlled fixture.

Fixture gained get_product routing + an A2A message/send endpoint returning the checkout in a DataPart keyed a2a.ucp.checkout; ctx gained has_a2a/a2a_endpoint; engine gained a2a_call. Independent review verified citations exact (catalog/mcp.md:693 both-tools, order-mcp.md:292 get_order, checkout-a2a.md:144 a2a.ucp.checkout) and subjects server-side. It REFUTED an A2A over-strictness bug (predicate accepted only the Message shape, would false-fail the spec-permitted Task shape at checkout-a2a.md:115-116) — FIXED before shipping: p_a2a_checkout_datapart now recursively finds the DataPart across Message result.parts, Task status.message.parts, and artifacts[].parts (unit-tested: CLEAN on all 3 shapes, DEVIATION on missing-datapart / ucp-less checkout). All 3 clean-pass + kill-safe on the controlled fixture.

Re-read ap2-mandates.md at each cited clause. PAY-034 (L106, include merchant_authorization in all checkout responses) + PAY-039 (L140, embed under ap2.merchant_authorization as JWS detached content) -> payment.ap2_authorization_present: binds the merchant_authorization field, asserts detached-JWS shape (header..sig); mutations drop it / set non-JWS / empty ap2 are all caught (3/3 kill-safe). PAY-031 (L29, signature proves terms authentic) + PAY-040 (L172, covers header+payload, alg-substitution defense) + PAY-043 (L218, JCS RFC 8785) -> payment.ap2_authorization_authentic: verifies the detached JWS over JCS(checkout minus ap2) with an ES256-required header. Not over-strict: accepts a key-reordered but JCS-equal payload (proven at the ap2-crypto gate). Coverage split stated honestly: the check's own mutations prove PAYLOAD coverage (currency/quantity/amount edits rejected); HEADER/alg-substitution coverage (PAY-040) is enforced by the predicate and proven by the ap2-crypto gate's alg-swap vector, since the engine cannot re-sign. Fixture signature is genuine (generated by common/crypto, re-verified each run by the checks + ap2-crypto gate). Enforce-side AP2 MUSTs (PAY-035/038/045/047) deliberately left as gaps — no AP2 reference server exists (ops/scope-ap2-mandate-cluster). VALIDATED vs INDEPENDENT oracles (2026-07-16): JCS passes all 6 official RFC 8785 vectors (fixed a number-serialization + UTF-16 key-order bug found by them); JWS-detached interops both ways with the `cryptography` lib. Spec allows alg ES256/ES384/ES512 — ES384/ES512 route to INCONCLUSIVE (not a false deviation), invalid algs to DEVIATION.

signoffs.reviewer: adversarial review, AP2 enforce-side + nested-binding cluster
signoffs.notes: Re-read ap2-mandates.md at each cited clause (pinned vendor copy). PAY-035 (L108, MUST NOT accept complete without ap2.checkout_mandate) + PAY-044 (L241, security-locked flow, bypass MUST fail) + PAY-045 (L333/244, completion without mandates MUST result in session failure) + PAY-047 (L380, reject with mandate_required) -> payment.ap2_complete_requires_mandate (merchant_checks_04_08_ap2): BEHAVIORAL live check, capability-gated on dev.ucp.shopping.ap2_mandate so non-AP2 merchants skip honestly; creates a session then attempts completion WITHOUT a mandate; CLEAN only on a 4xx carrying the spec-registered mandate_required code (envelope-agnostic value search — the spec pins the CODE, not the error-body shape). PAY-038 (L121, unresolvable key / invalid signature MUST return an error) -> payment.ap2_invalid_mandate_rejected: completion with an unverifiable mandate must 4xx with mandate_invalid_signature (agent_missing_key also accepted — a merchant that fails at key RESOLUTION first is equally spec-registered; ambiguity stated, not hidden). PAY-042 (L207, mandate MUST contain the FULL checkout including ap2.merchant_authorization; L395-408 nested re-verification) -> payment.ap2_mandate_nested_binding (area_04_08_ap2): fixture check over a reference-minted golden chain embedding our schema-valid checkout; predicate = independent frozen-layer verification (checkout_hash identity, merchant-signed checkout_jwt, embedded merchant_authorization present + verifying over JCS(checkout minus ap2)). KILL-PROOFS: engine mutations 5/5+5/5 (status:200 acceptance, dropped/wrong code, corrupt/empty) and 3/3 (dropped/garbage/empty wire); the DEEP kill-proofs live in dedicated gates, ORD-012 pattern: validate_ap2_enforce boots the fixture --ap2 (both MChecks clean-pass + kill_safe; every spec error code exercised live incl. the TRUE scope case — a fully VALID mandate for a different real session -> mandate_scope_mismatch) and --ap2-no-enforce (the emitting-but-not-enforcing merchant: both MChecks DEVIATE); validate_ap2_e2e's nested tier proves the PAY-042 negatives that PASS the generic chain layer (missing mAuth / terms tampered after signing / hash mismatch) are caught ONLY by the nested verifier. Mandates presented by the checks are minted by our own frozen-layer primitives (testbed/mint.py), whose wire the OFFICIAL reference verifier accepts with zero violations (e2e.our_mint_reference_interop — two-way interop). Not over-strict: a 4xx without the required code is a DEVIATION per L380's explicit code mandate; scope/expiry/nested rejections are exercised at the gate, not demanded of live merchants beyond the spec text. agent_missing_key remains untested live (needs platform-profile key-resolution modeling, queued with PAY-037 — stated as a residual, not claimed).

Re-read ap2-mandates.md Signing Key Requirements (L115-122, pinned copy): a public signing key MUST be available for the business to verify the mandate's signature — platform-provider flow resolves it from the PLATFORM profile's top-level signing_keys. -> payment.ap2_signing_key_resolution (merchant_checks_04_08_ap2): BEHAVIORAL live check, capability-gated on dev.ucp.shopping.ap2_mandate AND config-gated on ap2_mandates.platform_profile_no_keys_url (the merchant must be able to FETCH the supplied key-less platform profile — the negotiation checks' config-supplied-URL pattern; merchants without a reachable probe skip honestly). The check presents a mandate under a UCP-Agent whose profile publishes NO usable signing_keys: key resolution MUST fail before any signature can verify, surfacing the spec-registered agent_missing_key code on a 4xx (envelope-agnostic value search). POSITIVE control at the gate: the fixture in --ap2 mode does REAL loopback profile resolution — the published mint platform key verifies a valid mandate end-to-end (completed), a key-less profile is agent_missing_key, and a resolvable-but-WRONG key is mandate_invalid_signature (resolution and verification failures kept distinct). KILL-PROOFS: engine mutations 5/5 (status:200 acceptance, dropped/wrong code, corrupt/empty); ORD-012-pattern gate proof: clean-pass + kill_safe vs the --ap2 golden, DEVIATION vs the --ap2-no-enforce mutant. Not over-strict: only the CODE is demanded (the spec's error table pins it), never an envelope shape; non-loopback fixture flows keep the deterministic-key contract so the check never grades a merchant on our fixture conventions.

Re-read the pinned registers at all three versions for every check the 2026-08-03 golden re-pin (reference now speaks 2026-04-08) had left mis-scoped. Renumber-mappings re-verified verbatim against the pinned spec: IDM-004@01-era == CHK-048@04-08 (checkout-rest.md#L1219 vs #L1242, identical 409-on-conflict clause); DISC-007@01-era == DISC-005@04-08 (overview.md#L152 vs #L147, valid HTTPS service endpoint); NEG-016@01-era == NEG-001@04-08 (overview.md#L1157 vs #L699 — 04-08 adds the 422 mapping; AMB-001: spec authoritative over the official suite's 01-era 400; predicate accepts any 4xx and requires the version_unsupported code when a messages[] envelope is present, so it is never stronger than either register). Version-locks re-verified: VAL-001/002/003/004 pin exact HTTP statuses only in the 01-era registers (overview.md#L1032-L1033); the 04-08 register replaced them with the messages[] envelope MUSTs (ERR-028/029/030, covered by the 04-08 ERR checks) plus MAY-level codes (ERR-008), and some outcomes map to 200-with-envelope (NEG-002, CAT-019/020) — running them at 04-08 would assert an unpinned status (false-deviation generator), so versions=(2026-01-11,2026-01-23). Same grounds for VAL-006 (engine twin), ORD-012/013 event-envelope webhook checks (04-08 renumbered those ids onto order-data auth; the reference delivers the 04-08 full-order-entity contract, covered by validate_webhook_reference + webhook.order_created_full_entity). DISC-013 and NEG-015 have NO 04-08 row (profile-version duty is schema-anchored: ucp.json $defs.base requires version, graded by DISC-000) -> req_ids_map 04-08 -> [] anchors. All three renumbered ids were ALREADY covered+signed at 04-08 by their 04-08-native checks; this batch records the re-verification that the version-adaptive merchant/engine contributors grade the same clauses. Every touched check re-proven clean-pass + kill_safe on the goldens it now claims (flower 04-08, controlled 04-08/01-23/01-11), with the served-version gate itself mutant-proven by validate_version_scope.py.

Every row's pinned quote was re-read at conformance/.vendor/ucp (tag 2026-04-08) before its check shipped; each check was proven RED-first against the pre-change fixture (15 deviated as false-deviation generators until the behavior was implemented; the rest were killed via their declared response mutations), then clean-pass + kill_safe on all three controlled goldens. OVERVIEW: OVR-001/003 grade the served profile against the reverse_domain_name.json grammar and the Spec-URL-Binding authority table (first-two-labels reversed; services always carry the URLs, so no vacuous pass); OVR-009/010 follow the live supported_versions map to a leaf profile (fixture now serves version-specific leaves; leaf must still BE a profile so absence cannot pass); OVR-004 sweeps checkout+cart+catalog responses (fetch returns any offender); OVR-008 on the response media type; OVR-005 graded twice — operation-type relevance on checkout responses AND a loopback platform-profile harness proving the session-scoped intersection excludes an unadvertised extension; OVR-012's observable was deliberately NOT an envelope assertion (an orphan's parent can never be the op root, so envelope exclusion is confounded with relevance) — instead a discount-only platform profile makes the RAW intersection non-empty and only negotiation step 3 can empty it, forcing capabilities_incompatible; a step-3-skipping merchant creates the checkout and deviates. CHECKOUT: CHK-013 replay-equality on a normative projection (ids/urls excluded); CHK-050 on the spec-pinned 409 idempotency conflict (code+content body); CHK-051/053 required RECONTRACTING the golden — 04-08 makes unavailable merchandise a business outcome (200 + envelope/messages; all-unavailable = ucp.status:error with NO resource), so validation.out_of_stock (VAL-001, a 01-era 4xx contract) was version-scoped to 01-era exactly like VAL-006 before it. DSC-013 clears codes via update and requires the automatic entry to survive. PAY-014 asserts the session is NOT completed after an unknown-handler_id completion (fixture now validates against the advertised set; goldens' configs point at spck_tokenpay). PAY-015 needs two cart contexts: a seeded context-sensitive handler (dev.spck.giftpay) present on the baseline and absent for the excluded product; predicate also requires the base handler to survive filtering. PAY-041 mirrors the reviewed 01-era PAY-029 schema check (resolver-anchored SD-JWT mandate on the ap2-composed complete request; payment_mandate shape anchored by PAY-024 — the same honest split, documented in-line). SAE-008 compares projections with/without the top-level attribution object; SAE-012 rides eligibility.completion_blocked because context.json's own sentence IS that scenario (context-carried claim enforced at completion with binding data). SIGNATURES: SIG-009's graded observable is a rotated-within-window key still verifying, with a tampered-signature precondition so acceptance cannot be vacuous (the 7-day clock itself is not black-box observable — documented); SIG-016/018 extend the webhook capture to the idempotency-key/ucp-agent signed components (merchant is the signer only for webhooks, per the earlier reclassification); SIG-041 rides webhook.ucp_agent_header whose predicate already asserts the /.well-known/ucp business-profile path (signatures.md rule 4); SIG-040 rides discovery.reject_http_profile_url (same verifier duty, quoted-http-URL probe). SIG-023/024 use opt-in test hooks (mint-hook precedent): age a stored key 23h and require the cached replay (retention >= 24h), and arm a storage outage requiring fail-closed 503 with code+content. SIG-035 was re-adjudicated against wave-3 F1: F1 correctly removed the bogus-alg-PARAMETER probe (alg is not a Signature-Input parameter), but a PUBLISHED signing_keys entry whose crv-derived algorithm the verifier does not support is a spec-true wire trigger — resolution succeeds, algorithm cannot, the registry maps it to 400 algorithm_unsupported (fixture publishes an Ed25519 kid; key_not_found stays distinct). CART-030 uses the CHK-035 precedent: the official RESOLVER removes cart_id from the update-request resolution and retains it on create (per-op ucp_request annotation; a plain validator cannot see it — the register note says exactly that). OAUTH: IDL-025 closes the W2-F5 bar with the third mint scenario (foreign_client — client_id/azp binding) alongside expired/revoked; cited ONLY on the new check; the --oauth-accept-any-token mutant proves the server-level kill. IDL-061 compares the RFC 8414 issuer and the authorization-response iss byte-for-byte (evil-iss and iss-less Location mutations kill). OVR-006 proves the same token unlocks the gated op under the client's REGISTERED profile and is 401/403-rejected under a conflicting UCP-Agent profile (--oauth-no-profile-binding mutant proves the kill; rejection-only predicate per the DISC-004 p_rejected_4xx precedent — the spec pins no code). Fixture recontracts were oracle-anchored: the cart selfcheck's wrong anchor (cart.json $defs/checkout, vacuously green pre-OVR-004) was moved to the cart.json ROOT whose envelope is response_cart_schema.

signoffs.reviewer: adversarial review (model-diverse Fable pass) + spec re-read, 01-era receiver closure (lane-recv01)
signoffs.notes: Extended receiver-based coverage to the 01-era (2026-01-11 + 2026-01-23) against the CONTROLLED fixture goldens booted --spec-version 2026-01-23 (:8185) and 2026-01-11 (:8193); each check is clean-pass + kill_safe on BOTH (merchant-ctrl-01-23 / merchant-ctrl-01-11 gates). Every cited row's pinned quote was re-read under conformance/.vendor/ucp-2026-01-23 and ucp-2026-01-11 before its check shipped. FOUR MUSTs converted at both versions: CHK-037 (checkout.md#L267 'Logic handling the checkout sessions MUST be deterministic') — replay an identical create twice with fresh idempotency keys and compare a normative projection that now includes the advertised payment-handler set and continue_url presence (closes a randomized-handler false-pass); a first create that is not 2xx, or a difference explained solely by an inventory/availability STATE change the first call caused, grades INCONCLUSIVE not DEVIATION (closes the stock-reservation false-fail). NEG-010 (overview.md 'Business Requirements'/'Intersection Algorithm' — compute the platform/business capability intersection) and NEG-011 (exclude orphan extensions) — a loopback platform profile (Harness0408; the fixture's negotiator reads only capability KEYS) drives create with a DISJOINT capability set (NEG-010) or a {discount}-only ORPHAN set (NEG-011, preconditioned on the business itself advertising the discount extension so the empty result is attributable to orphan-exclusion, not plain disjointness); the business MUST NOT create a session and MUST return an error response. PAY-012 (overview.md#L642 dynamic handler filtering) — baseline offers the context-sensitive gift handler, a restricted basket omits it; split into two version-scoped checks each reading its NORMATIVE handler shape (ucp.payment_handlers @01-23, root payment.handlers @01-11) so a non-normative echo in the other shape cannot false-flag. FIXTURE (ours, modeling a conformant 01-era server): added a 01-era negotiation path returning the pinned Error Handling envelope (top-level status:requires_escalation + a type:error message, HTTP 200 per AMB-006, NO checkout id) when the intersection empties, and a context-sensitive gift handler + filter in both 01-era handler shapes. MODEL-DIVERSE ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (Fable) ran on the first draft and found real holes; all were fixed or the candidate DROPPED — no bar lowered: (E) the NEG predicate+fixture had co-invented a 04-08 'capabilities_incompatible' ucp.status:error contract absent from the pinned 01-era tree (grep: zero hits) — reworked to assert ONLY the pinned Error Handling facts (no created session + a type:error message), no invented code; NEG-011 now preconditions on the business advertising the extension so orphan-exclusion is attributable, not disjointness. (B) CHK-037 false-pass (handler/continue_url nondeterminism) and false-fail (stock reservation, transient first create) — fixed via the projection additions + INCONCLUSIVE guards above. (F) PAY-012 cross-shape union false-fail — fixed by reading the served version's normative shape (per-version split). FOUR candidates were DROPPED rather than shipped weak, and stay documented GAPs: CHK-015 ('the business sets the status') rests on keyword-free lifecycle prose and its probe (status in the create body) is ucp_request:omit-invalid, so a schema-strict conformant server would be false-failed; ORD-011 is a PLATFORM-subject row (the platform provides webhook_url) whose merchant-observable analogue ORD-012 (business POSTs to the platform-provided URL) is already covered by area_webhook.py; ORD-017 ('business identifier in webhook path OR headers') cannot be made both sound and non-vacuous here — the harness path is platform-provisioned and already carries a per-business token, so crediting the path is vacuous while requiring a specific header over-asserts the spec's disjunction; NEG-009 ('fetch AND validate the platform profile') has its 'fetch' half evidenced but its 'validate' half unexercised (no malformed-profile rejection modeled). CHK-039/ERR-008 remain GAP per AMB-009 (prose 'severity: escalation' contradicts the pinned message_error.json enum). Version scoping verified: all three files carry the 01_11/01_23 filename tokens AND versions=('2026-01-11','2026-01-23') (PAY-012 split checks scope to a single 01-era version each), so matrix.py attributes every NEG/CHK/PAY citation to the 01-era lanes only — no leak to 2026-04-08 (which stays 98%, 169/169 merchant-ctrl sound).
